_doc: Region recipe: The Red Reaches (Aruun's homeland). Data only; schema in design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Extra keys read by game/world/region/region_runner.gd: 'spokes' (named side areas hanging off the critical path: geometry lives in the level layout.json floors, this file holds the entry trigger, blurb and codex), 'sites' (interactable points: event / cache / lore, optionally secret = revealed by SCAN or proximity). Critical path beats stay in the level script; spokes are optional.
name: The Red Reaches
summary: Plateaus, mineral deserts and fracture valleys. Settlements survive because generations maintain the bridges, wells and roads. Strength is the burden you can accept without forcing it onto someone weaker.

layers.feel: a crossroads; paths lead off in every direction

surfaces.desc: Old cut stone of the Spanwrights

ground.relief: mesa plateaus cut by fracture valleys

props.note: Old Road markers; glyphs seen continents apart.

world_states.label: Extraction
world_states.effect: Dominion surveyors work the side valleys; salvage is contested.

spokes.name: Echo Hollow
spokes.blurb: A dry side-cut off the valley. Sound carries strangely here.
spokes.fresh: A side-cut leads off the valley. Optional.

spokes.name: Drover's Rest
spokes.blurb: The north spur from the Waystation. A cart road, stalled.
spokes.fresh: Cart ruts lead north from the Waystation. Optional.

spokes.name: The Salt Pans
spokes.blurb: The south spur. White flats, an old well, and something glinting under the crust.
spokes.fresh: A white salt flat lies south of the Waystation. Optional.

spokes.name: The Thoughtstone Vault
spokes.blurb: A sealed spanwright vault off the Boulder Pass. Closed is still working.
spokes.fresh: A sealed door waits north of the pass. Optional.

spokes.name: The Drowned Cistern
spokes.blurb: A hidden cleft behind the survey camp. Cold air, still water, no light.
spokes.fresh: A hidden cleft opens in the basin wall.

spokes.name: Spanwright Overlook
spokes.blurb: A ledge above the Ochre Span. The whole crossing is visible from here.
spokes.fresh: A ledge climbs north of the Span approach. Optional.

sites.label: Dig
sites.text: A seam of Thoughtstone dust under the glyphs.

sites.label: Search
sites.text: Spare axle parts. The drover waves you on.

sites.label: Dig
sites.text: A buried lichen bed, perfectly preserved in salt.

sites.label: Read the cairn
sites.text: A cairn of survey stones, one for every crew that crossed. The newest is three weeks old.

descent_events.title: The echo wall
descent_events.text: A wall of Old Road glyphs, older than the valley's present shape. Speak near it and the glyphs answer in your own voice, a half-second late.

choices.label: Copy the glyphs into the Codex.
choices.result: Aruun traces them with a steady hand. 'Maintenance marks. Someone was keeping this road for people they would never meet.'

choices.label: Leave the wall as it is.
choices.result: You step back. The echo settles into silence, as if grateful.

choices.label: Pry the glyph plates off for salvage.
choices.result: The plates come away easily. The echo does not come back.

descent_events.title: A stalled cart
descent_events.text: A drover's cart sits axle-deep in a rut, a day's flour sacks tied on top. The drover is trying to unload it alone, one sack at a time.

choices.label: Brace the cart while the drover re-sets the wheel.
choices.result: Aruun takes the weight without being asked. The wheel goes on; the drover says nothing, which is the highest compliment on the road.

choices.label: Offer salvage for a share of the flour.
choices.result: A fair trade. Everyone keeps something.

choices.label: Take the flour and leave the cart.
choices.result: The drover watches you go. He does not shout.

descent_events.title: The well keeper
descent_events.text: A keeper sits by the Salt Pans well with a patch kit. The well still gives water, but the pump housing is cracked, and the Dominion survey wants it condemned.

choices.label: Help patch the housing.
choices.result: An afternoon of work. The keeper writes your crew's mark on the well stone: one more name in the repair record.

choices.label: Sign the Dominion condemnation.
choices.result: The survey is pleased. The keeper pours the water out slowly.

choices.label: Ask what the keeper needs first.
choices.result: 'A hand, mostly,' the keeper says, surprised to be asked. You get a better patch than you would have made alone.

descent_events.title: The sealed vault
descent_events.text: A Spanwright vault door, closed but humming. Its pulse-lock is still working. Behind it, something stores weight the way a bridge does: carefully.

choices.label: Leave it sealed.
choices.result: A closed vault is still doing its job. The hum steadies.

choices.label: Press at the lock to learn where it came from.
choices.result: The lock yields its maker's mark and nothing else. You learn a name and open nothing.

choices.label: Force the door.
choices.result: It opens on a rush of cold air and a small stash of dust. The humming stops. You feel it stop.

descent_events.title: The dark water
descent_events.text: The cistern is dark and perfectly still. Something rests below the surface. Cigarra's scanner is already warming; the rest of the party is quiet.

choices.label: Leave the water dark.
choices.result: Nobody says anything. You back out as you came in. Whatever slept there goes on sleeping.

choices.label: Shine a lamp and scan it.
choices.result: The water lights up: a sleeper, curled, startled. It does not forgive the light.

descent_events.title: The load marks
descent_events.text: From the overlook the Ochre Span looks like a held breath. Past crews scratched their load limits into the rail. Some of the numbers have been scored out and re-written, bigger.

choices.label: Mark a safe crossing order and an exit for the convoy.
choices.result: Aruun adds his number below the others, in smaller letters than they used. It is the only one that is still correct.

choices.label: Scratch in a heavier number than anyone's.
choices.result: It looks impressive. It is not accurate.

choices.label: Take note of the rail and move on.
choices.result: You note the numbers and say nothing.
